about: Where each owner class is filed. `python3 tools/placement.py check` fails when a function headed `Class_Action` is outside its class's homes and isn't a reviewed exception, and when a class has no rule. The first rule whose pattern matches the class decides. A home is a file or a folder (trailing /); `{snake}` is the class in snake case; `*` is anywhere. Edit by hand: a new class gets a rule when its first function is written (AGENTS.md, "One port per original function").
